---
title: "DNA Origami Hybrid Nanopores"
subtitle: "Published research"
---

DNA origami structures can be captured at solid-state nanopores, creating a hybrid sensing interface.

## Research question

How does adding a folded DNA structure change protein measurements through a solid-state nanopore?

## Approach

The published study compares measurements of holo human serum transferrin using open solid-state nanopores and DNA origami hybrid nanopores. The approach combines ionic-current measurements with analysis of molecular events.

## Research scope

The article reports improved protein sensing with DNA origami integration. The complete methods, results, and limitations are available in the peer-reviewed paper.

## Publication

[Joty et al., Analytical Chemistry (2024)](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.analchem.4c02016).
